title: Simply Perfected
description: This Modpack is a Fork of Simply Optimized that adds all the Features you want!
body:
# 🌟 Simply Perfected

Simply Perfected is a carefully refined fork of [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)
, designed to bring you the perfect **blend of performance, visuals, and quality-of-life improvements** — all without breaking the vanilla feel.

## 💡 What is Simply Perfected?

Simply Perfected builds upon the solid foundation of Simply Optimized, keeping its lightweight performance focus while adding **hand-picked Quality of Life, visual, and utility mods** that make your gameplay **smoother and more enjoyable.**

This pack also includes **resource packs** to enhance visuals subtly — keeping Minecraft looking clean, sharp, and immersive.

> ⚠️ **Note**: Shaders are **not supported** in this version. **Iris** is intentionally excluded for maximum compatibility and performance stability.

> ⚠️ **Another Note**: This Mod is Mainly Client-Side but be Careful if using in Server as Some Mods like **Easy Magic** can get you banned.

## 🧩 What’s Inside

Here’s a full list of the mods included in **Simply Perfected:**

### ⚙️ Performance Mods

- Sodium

- Sodium Extra

- Lithium

- Scalable Lux

- Immediately Fast

- Entity Culling

- Bad Optimizations

- More Culling

- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (C2ME)

- FerriteCore

- Very Many Players

### 🖥️ GUI Mods

- Reese’s Sodium Options

- Mod Menu

- OptiGUI (Technically a library, but fits the GUI category)

### 🌍 Quality-of-Life Mods

- Sounds

- 3D Skin Layers

- Zoomify

- Mouse Tweaks

- LambDynamicLights

- Easy Anvil

- Easy Magic

- Resourcify

- CustomSkinLoader

- WorldEdit

- Visuality

- Sound Physics Remastered

### 🎨 Resource Packs

- Visual Armor Trims

- Recolorful Containers

- Qrafty’s Capitalized Font

- Vanilla Tweaks (Customized for Things like 3D Mace, Classic Armor Etc. Check the Original Website [here](https://vanillatweaks.net/))

### 🧱 Library / API Mods

- Fabric API

- Cloth Config API

- Puzzles Lib

- Raise Sound Limit Simplified

- Text Placeholder API

- YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)

- M.R.U

- Fabric Language Kotlin

- Forge Config API Port

- Entity Model Features (EMF)

- Entity Texture Features (ETF)

- OptiGUI

## 🚀 Installation Guide

1. Download the latest `.mrpack` file from the Versions page.

2. Import it into any launcher that **supports .mrpack format**, such as:

- Prism Launcher

- ATLauncher

- SKLauncher

Alternatively, just search “Simply Perfected” directly in the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)
 and hit Install — it’s that easy.

## ❤️ Why You’ll Love It

- ⚡ **Optimized for speed** — built on Simply Optimized’s legendary performance base.

- 🧠 **Enhanced with QOL** — smoother gameplay, smarter tools, and better visuals.

- 🪄 **Still Vanilla-Friendly** — feels like Minecraft, just better.
